headline: イラン・中東情勢、FRBが市場の主な焦点
executive_summary: 重要度Aのテーマは2件です。市場データは未取得または限定的です。投資判断ではなく、公開情報の整理として確認してください。

sections.title: イラン・中東情勢
sections.summary: イラン・中東情勢では、Thailand urges Iran to allow safe passage of 8 stranded Thai vessels through Hormuz /   No international waters on Strait of Hormuz  Iran / Trump Warns Iran :  Clock is Ticking  on Nuclear Deal が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: FRB
sections.summary: FRBでは、Federal Reserve Board releases results from two surveys of senior financial officers at banks about their views on discount window operating days and their strategies and practices for managing reserve balances / Federal Reserve Board names Jerome H. Powell as chair pro tempore; Powell will serve as chair pro tempore until Kevin M. Warsh is sworn in as the new chair / Minutes of the Board's discount rate meeting on April 20 and 29, 2026 が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: 為替
sections.summary: 為替では、SON DAKİKA I İran nükleer müzakereleri kabul etti : ABDden Tahrana karşı yeni adım ! İsrailin saldırıları en büyük engel ...  が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: 要人発言
sections.summary: 要人発言では、Barr, Measuring Financial Health / Waller, Policy Risks Have Changed / Cook, The Opportunities and Risks AI Presents for the Economy and Financial System が主な確認材料です。

sections.title: その他
sections.summary: その他では、  Если пожелает Аллах : Иран клянется не разрабатывать ядерное оружие / İran ile ABD arasında 60 günlük ateşkes bugün duyurulabilir : İşte anlaşma şartları / Из США пришли тревожные для Израиля сигналы : вырисовывается опасный сценарий が主な確認材料です。
